products.name: Arthur AI
products.note: Model monitoring and governance; bias mitigation; fairness metrics; compliance reporting

profile_text.body:
Arthur AI is a software company that describes itself as providing AI governance for enterprise organizations. Its platform is designed to serve as a single control plane connecting security teams, finance teams, and the engineering and product teams that build and deploy AI systems. The company positions its offering as model-, framework-, and use-case-agnostic, meaning it is built to handle traditional machine learning models, generative AI, and agentic systems within one unified environment.

The core product, also called Arthur AI, covers model monitoring, observability, guardrails, governance policy enforcement, and compliance reporting, including bias mitigation and fairness metrics. Arthur describes the platform as spanning the full AI lifecycle, from development through production, and frames the central problem it solves as the disconnect between the people who govern AI and the people who build it. Customer quotes on the site claim the platform reduced model monitoring maintenance workload by 50 percent and that initial production deployments moved from concept to implementation within a few hours.

The held facts confirm Arthur AI maintains a tracked product listing in the AI governance and risk management category, with no recorded litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC or patent filings noted at this time.
